{{Quote|<s></s>''What the blazes''? They're ''firing'' at us!''"<br />"''That's what Mandalorians ''do'', dear.|Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo, as they are attacked by Mandalorians outside the Krabbis Inn|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
The '''R-20 scatterblaster''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] model created by the arms manufacturer [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. The blaster could be wielded with one hand and could also fire a large volley of tiny bolts all at once. That function made it particularly useful against [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who were unable to deflect so many little bolts simultaneously with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The R-20 scatterblaster was used by [[Mandalorian Supercommando]]s around [[43 ABY]].

==Description==
The R-20 scatterblaster was a relatively small [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] that could be held and fired with just one hand. When triggered, it discharged a rapid barrage of very small blaster bolts. The model of blaster was known to be particularly useful for combat against [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] opponents, as they were unable to deflect the salvo of tiny bolts with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] all at once.<ref name="Abyss" />

==History==
Sometime prior to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'' to [[43 ABY]].</ref> [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]],<ref name="Abyss" /> a prominent arms manufacturer,<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> designed and released the R-20 scatterblaster. The scatterblaster was used by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors, specifically [[Mandalorian Supercommando|Supercommandos]]. In 43.5 ABY, when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Jaden Korr]], [[Tekli]], and [[Avinoam Arelis]], along with Organa Solo's husband, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], attempted to evacuate three [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] Jedi Knights from the [[New Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a group of Mandalorian Supercommandos hired by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] [[Skirmish at the Krabbis Inn|attacked]] them outside of the [[Krabbis Inn]], a hostel near the Jedi Temple. One of the Supercommandos, armed with an R-20 scatterblaster, opened fire on Organa Solo, forcing her to retreat behind a nearby bridge. The Mandalorians were eventually defeated, however, and the psychotic Jedi were successfully evacuated from the Temple.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
The R-20 scatterblaster was created by established ''[[Star Wars]]'' author [[Troy Denning]] for his first installment&mdash;and the third novel overall&mdash;in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', released [[August 18]], [[2009]].
